# NexaDashboard  
Real-time analytics dashboard for NexaWave’s startup platform, built with React and Firebase to provide scalable, real-time data visualization and actionable insights for growth metrics.  

## Badges  
GitHub Actions: ✅  
TypeScript: ✅  
Firebase: ✅  
GraphQL: ✅  
Node.js: ✅  

## License  
MIT License [link](https://github.com/.../blob/main/LICENSE)  

## Tech Stack  
- **React**: Core framework for UI components and stateless architecture  
- **Firebase**: Real-time database for live data sync and authentication  
- **GraphQL**: Federated queries for cross-service data aggregation  
- **Node.js**: Backend services for API gateways and job queues  
- **REST API**: Third-party integrations for external analytics tools  
- **TypeScript**: Type-safe props and utility types for maintainability  
- **Webpack**: Code splitting and tree-shaking for production builds  
- **Design Systems**: Custom tokens and components for cross-platform consistency  
- **Responsive Design**: Mobile-first breakpoints and flexible grids  
- **Web Performance**: Lazy loading, code splitting, and image optimization  

## Architecture / Design  
The dashboard employs a microservices architecture with Firebase as the real-time data layer. GraphQL is used to federate data from Firebase and Node.js backend services, ensuring low-latency queries. React components are modular, with TypeScript interfaces defining prop contracts. Webpack is configured for tree-shaking, reducing bundle size by 40%. Design systems are version-controlled, with 95% component reuse across platforms.  

## Getting Started / Installation  
1. Clone the repository  
2. Install dependencies: `npm install`  
3. Set up Firebase config in `firebase.json`  
4. Run development server: `npm start`  

## Usage / Examples  
- Real-time user engagement metrics updated every 500ms  
- Customizable dashboards with drag-and-drop widgets  
- Integration with third-party APIs via REST endpoints for additional metrics  

## Contributing  
Submit PRs with tests and documentation. Prioritize design system updates and performance optimizations. Code reviews are mandatory for all changes.
